notes.title: Mother's Day Big Game Update and Discount!
notes.notes:
Happy Mother's Day!

We have prepared a big game update for you for this very important day!
- Special new mother : The Great Mother. present flowers to the great mother!
- New mothers speaking Spanish and Portuguese.
- Mother's eyes will now blink from time to time.
- New customization for Steam workshop, you can now replace ".motion3" animations such as the slap and idle animation.

Also <Your Mother> will be on sale with a 20% discounted price for a limited time, a great gift for friends and family during Mother's Day.

Have fun! And remember please be nice to your mother : )

notes.title: April Game Update
notes.notes:
NEW:
- New mothers: Russian mother, and mother with a timer.
- Soul-like gameplay: You can new perfect parry mother's slap.
- Added mother's animated avatars to Steam Points Shop.
- Character visual mod support on Steam Workshop (Beta): Please read the guideline here: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3425947395]https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3425947395[/url]

Bug fixes and game optimization:
- New game setting to change the size of subtitles.
- Added new button to open Steam Workshop.
- Fix a bug: quiet mother keep speaking.
- Fix a bug: wrong outfit is displayed when switching characters.

We hope you like this update. Please leave us your feedback in discussion forum or our communities, especially we need more feedback on how to improve the Steam Workshop features. 

See you in the next BIG DAY on May! ❤️

notes.title: v1.02 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
- fixed some text display problem for some languages
- fixed some random issues when switching languages
- fixed problem where it is possible to be stucked with alien mother

Thank you for playing, we will continue to collect feedbacks in our communities and improve the game.
